finance_puzzle.question: A company has Revenue = ₹1500 Cr, EBITDA margin = 22%, Debt = ₹200 Cr, Interest rate = 9%. What happens to profit (before tax) if revenue falls 5%?
finance_puzzle.answer:
Old EBITDA = ₹330 Cr → Profit before interest cost of ₹18 Cr = ₹312 Cr.
New revenue = ₹1425 Cr → New EBITDA = ₹314 Cr → New profit before tax = ₹296 Cr.
That's a change of ₹-16 Cr — notice how a 5% revenue fall swings profit by a much bigger percentage. That's operating leverage.
